design.decision: Bid high and make it exactly, dumping spare winners. Sandbagging a low bid pays little.
design.opponent: Shown on the first exact make. Opponents can force overtricks on this team.
design.rationale: seed-exact-points (-4.5) pays the same for a sandbagged 4 as for a 9. Scaling with the contract fixes that and puts Exact under the bid-tension target. Departure: scaling plus a result condition, both in familiar terms.
design.draftText: +15 contract points for each trick in your team's contract if your team makes its contract exactly

critic.concerns: Same signature as cc-exact-per-trick, differing only in amount; merge them.

history.note: draft-common: also proposed as cc-exact-per-trick with a different amount.
